# Welcome!

::: column-margin
![](Hicks_Headshot.jpg)
:::

I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Political Science at the University of Wisconsin--Madison working on problems in international political economy and international organization. My research interests include firms in trade, globalization and institutional trust, which I study using both observational and experimental tools. My dissertation project examines the role of corporate welfare policies in shaping firm-level export behavior. I am also affiliated with the Department of Statistics, where I am pursuing a Master's degree in Applied Statistics. Prior to UW, I completed my master's and B.A. in Political Science at McGill University.

I'd love to chat about your research. Feel free to reach out to me at **john\[dot\]hicks\[at\]wisc\[dot\]edu**.
